answer_1.quote: Text style transfer (TST) is a significant area in natural language processing, aiming to endow text with a new style without altering its meaning.

answer_2.quote: We use automatic metrics to assess attribute control, such as style accuracy (ACC) and content preservation (CP) after transfer... Additionally, we report the "G-score" (the geometric mean of ACC and CP)... For content preservation, we calculate Self-BLEU using SacreBLEU.

answer_4.quote: To supplement automatic metrics, we conducted human evaluations by sampling 50 instances from each dataset. Five participants were enlisted to assess each model based on three criteria: (1) strength of style transfer, (2) semantic integrity, and (3) sentence fluidity.
answer_4.guideline: Assess based on three criteria: (1) strength of style transfer, (2) semantic integrity, and (3) sentence fluidity.
